a.lede: Valve practically just flipped a switch to give gamers the ability to read optical drives directly from the Steam Frame.
a.title: Valve adds CD-ROM drive support to Steam Frame kernel, took less than ten minutes

b.lede: Throaty Mumbo turns his NES into a Windows-like desktop using an FPGA cartridge emulating an old Intel CPU, complete with a CD drive and internet capabilities, all without tearing the NES apart.
b.title: Modder turns NES into a Windows-like desktop with original hardware
